name: hunt_pb_leg15_ema20

source.title: Claude hunt 2026-10-20 (angle: pullbacks in the day trend): buy the 62 % pullback of a fresh 15-minute up leg (a higher swing high) while the 15-minute close is above its EMA(20); sell the mirror. Why it should pay: a higher swing high is the day's buyers breaking structure; the leg's owners reload on the way back at a better price and the next push makes a new high. The stop sits where the leg started: back there, the leg was not a leg. Who loses: the faders who sell the new high into the pullback, and the chasers who bought the top and stop out into the reload. Against the EMA(20) side the leg is a counter-trend bounce, so it is skipped.

entry.words: NQ 15-minute bars. Swing bars of 15 minutes from 00:00 ET: a swing high is a bar whose high is above both neighbours (known one bar late). A swing high above the swing high before it makes an UP leg, from the lowest low since that earlier swing high. Rest a BUY limit 62 % of the way back into the leg. The order lives until it fills, price trades above the leg's high, price gets to the level without an order, or a newer leg replaces it. A lower swing low makes a DOWN leg: the mirror, a SELL limit. Only when the 15-minute close at the order's placement is on the trade's side of the EMA(20) of 15-minute closes (a long above it). Stop at the leg's start, target 1.5 x the stop. Up to two trades a session pass, one at a time, flat 15:58.

taught: [owner 2026-10-10, families/pullback.py] the pullback into a swing leg: a higher swing high of the day's 15-minute swing bars makes the leg; a limit `level` of the way back into it; the structure level is the leg's start
[owner 2026-10-10, families/pullback.py] level 0.62 = the family's own default (the 'optimal trade entry' depth); not tuned
[Claude 2026-10-20, cl_disp15_ema_allday_k1p5 / cl_pm_first_bar_cdl_ema_15] the side gate on 15-minute bars: long only above the EMA(20) of 15-minute closes, short only below

[Claude hunt 2026-10-20] the pullback trades only WITH the day's side (the EMA20 gate) and with the hunt's exit: stop at the leg's start, target 1.5 x the stop; two trades a session pass (one per leg, the family's rule)

[prior knowledge, read 2026-10-20: WHAT_WORKS.md section 2-3] pullbacks / bounces WITHOUT a side gate are random (FVG bounce 49 % at 1R); the one gate that recurs among winners is a day-side gate; wide stops (30+ points) beat narrow ones. The pullback family itself has no taught run on file.
not_run: THE GATE: the open layer's price_ema(20) on 15-minute closes since 00:00 ET (EMA seeded with the day's first close), read when the limit is placed; a working order is not pulled when the close later crosses the EMA.

THE STOP: the leg's start (structure); its size differs trade to trade and is not known before the run (PREREG asks more than 20 points on average: read it off the result). The engine never puts it nearer than 0.25 x ATR.
THE RANDOM CONTROL: a structure stop has no level for a random entry; the lane's random entries take the median stop of the taught trades at the same 1.5R, any bar of the pass.
CAPPED PER SESSION PASS, NOT PER DAY: nyam, mid and pm are three passes, so a day can hold up to 6 trades and a trade of one pass may still be open when another pass enters.
Legs are followed from 00:00 ET; a leg known before 09:30 can get its order at the first close of the nyam pass if it is still live.
Limit fills need a one-tick trade-through (strict_limit); no entry in the last 5 minutes of a pass.
COSTS AND FILLS: the engine's own (1 tick of slippage on market and stop fills, $4 a round turn, tick replay).
FLAT: every trade is flat by 15:58 ET (13:13 on half days).
THE TEST DAYS (2025-07-01 on) ARE NOT READ by this sheet: build days only; the 3:1 block walk-forward comes later under PREREG.
